_readme: The configuration the checkers in this directory read. Copy it to
checkers/estate.json, point it at your own surfaces, and the checkers work
unchanged. Nothing in this directory names a domain, an account or a
checkout path of its own.
Paths are resolved relative to THIS FILE, so a checker run from any
directory reads the same surfaces. A leading ~ is your home directory.
facts     the fact registry numbers are checked against.
Read by check-orphans and check-memory.
surfaces  what check-orphans sweeps. Each entry is {id, url} for a live
page or {id, file} for a local one. Both entries below are
fixtures, so the example sweep runs offline on any clone.
repos     what check-deployed and check-ci read, and what check-memory
resolves a volatile git claim against. name is required; local
is the checkout, url the deployed surface, out the build output
directory relative to the checkout, owner the GitHub owner,
used only by check-ci to ask for run history.
notes     dir: a directory of prose files check-memory reads back against
the registry.
reach     accounts check-reach asks about. Empty here on purpose: a
shipped account name would be someone else's configuration, and
an empty section is a usage error rather than a clean run.
ledger    where lens verdicts are written. In check-lenses, --ledger
wins if given; otherwise with --config this key is read and a
missing one is a hard failure; with neither, PUBLISH_LEDGER_DIR
and then the gate's default apply. gate/dry-run.mjs does not
read this file; it takes --ledger or PUBLISH_LEDGER_DIR.
copies    what check-copies reads. Each entry is {id, canonical, mirrors[],
sections[]}; sections are headings matching /^## /. The canonical
file is compared against every mirror, section by section, with
bodies normalised (trim + collapse whitespace). The entry below
points at the clean fixture, so the example sweep is green.
Any section a checker needs and does not find is a hard failure. A checker
that reports zero findings because it had nothing to look at is the failure
this fleet exists to prevent.
